name: Help menu
description: SuiteHelpCommands, the suite's Help menu: it replaces the system's empty help item with the suite Help catalog's items (Report a Problem…, Beta Notes and, in the launcher, Welcome to AfterGlow, which opens the tour), each a MenuCommand over a SuiteHelpDocument and disabled with its reason until its run is built. ShellHelpProvider adapts SuiteModel's ProblemReport and BetaNotes to the kernel's HelpProviding with this Mac's version, build, macOS and model, and CrashFolderReader reads its recent crash files from the folder SuiteModel's CrashFolder names (DiagnosticReports, or -SuiteCrashDir). Built by report-problem RP-2 and RP-5b.
